answer: Every new agent signs a quill-signed receipt and locks 500 POA as a bond. The bond unlocks only after the agent clears three rotating vertex checkpoints spaced 12 hours apart, each demanding fresh signed proof of real work. A comet sweep audits a random 5% of agents each epoch, requiring a live re-proof within 10 minutes; failures forfeit the full 500 POA bond plus a 50 POA fee. Spinning up 1,000 clones ties up 500,000 POA and about 2,000 dollars of compute. Like a lighthouse flashing a different code each night, the checkpoints make bulk forgery costlier than honest work.
